product.name: Monoprice 8.0mm Professional Microphone Bulk Cable - Oxygen-Free 2-Conductor PVC Jacket 21AWG 500ft Black
product.description: Build your own custom balanced mono and unbalanced stereo patch cables using this Professional Microphone Bulk Cable from Monoprice!This cable features two 21AWG high-purity, oxygen-free copper conductors, a braided copper shield with 97.5% coverage, and a single drain wire. Each conductor is jacketed in color-coded PVC. Warning: This product may contain a chemical known to the State of California to cause cancer, birth defects, or other reproductive harm.
